records.text: Owens said, “I actually think” the profile reflects a frustrated reporter subjected to an “obvious grift,” with Erika Kirk expecting a glowing review while avoiding basic organizational and political questions.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Vanity Fair is traditionally left leaning. No, that's not this. OK, this is not a leftist hit piece. I actually think that what this piece is, is a frustrated reporter who for four months of her life is being forced to subject herself to an obvious grift. OK, where a woman who purports to be. ... A qualified CEO and chairwoman of a massive organization doesn't want to actually answer even the most basic questions about that organization, politics, and yet she's expecting you to just write up a shiny, glowing review of her. The piece reads to me like it's a reflection of that reporter's frustration, because you have the writer, who's a young woman, likely had to try hard in life, at least try harder than Erica (Erika Kirk).
